detail: A joint De La Rue / Bank of Botswana announcement, headlined 'Bank of Botswana announce introduction of a new polymer banknote, designed and printed by De La Rue', states that the new 10 pula polymer note was designed and printed by De La Rue; the note entered circulation on 1 February 2018. No contract value is given.
source_title: De La Rue: Bank of Botswana announce introduction of a new polymer banknote, designed and printed by De La Rue

detail: Bank of Jamaica Governor Richard Byles, in his speech at the launch of Jamaica's new series of banknotes, said: 'I extend our appreciation to the printers of Jamaica's currency notes - De La Rue.' The speech is published by the BIS in its Central Bankers' Speeches series. No contract value or term is given.
source_title: Richard Byles: Launch of Jamaica's new series of banknotes (BIS Central Bankers' Speeches)

detail: A World Banknote Store news item on Eswatini's new 20 lilangeni banknote states: 'It was printed by the German company Giesecke+Devrient.' The statement covers that denomination only; no contract or term is given.
source_title: New Eswatini banknote of 20 lilangeni: design, symbolism and meaning (World Banknote Store)

detail: A World Banknote Store news item on Cape Verde's new banknotes, released 15 April 2025, states of the 1,000 escudo note 'The note is printed by the renowned British company De La Rue' and of the 2,000 escudo note 'The note is also printed by De La Rue.' The statement covers those two denominations; no contract value is given.
source_title: Release of New Cape Verde Banknotes: Design Updates and Cultural Heritage (World Banknote Store)

detail: A World Banknote Store news item on Tajikistan's commemorative 100 somoni banknote, put into circulation 30 October 2025, states under security features: 'The printing house is Giesecke+Devrient (Germany).' The statement covers that commemorative note only.
source_title: New Commemorative 100 Somoni Banknote of Tajikistan (World Banknote Store)

detail: A World Banknote Store news item on the Eastern Caribbean Central Bank's updated 2027 banknote family states: 'The banknotes are printed on Safeguard polymer by De La Rue, size 70 x 145 mm, vertical orientation.' The ECCB announced the series on 9 July 2026. Separately, at the 2019 launch of the first EC polymer notes, Governor Timothy Antoine said 'I wish now to acknowledge the contribution of De La Rue with whom the ECCB has a long-term service agreement' (https://www.eccb-centralbank.org/news/governor-antoine-s-statement-at-launch-of-ec-polymer-notes). No contract value is given.
source_title: New Banknotes of the Eastern Caribbean States: 2027 Updated Family (World Banknote Store)
